screenshot_forest:
Having lost your way in the forest, you find a city
spread before you that seems to be the very one
described in the legend...
screenshot_city:
Gloomy though it is, the city is clearly inhabited,
and you can see its residents going about their
lives here and there.
screenshot_narration_labyrinth:
Then mist enveloped the city, and the surrounding forest
warped beneath his curse, becoming a bewildering
enclosure that cut the city off from the world. Monsters
were drawn in, and the city became a vast labyrinth.
screenshot_portrait_curse:
Does it sound strange to speak of being trapped
by a city? This city is bound by a curse cast long
ago by the great mage @7rChu Lu Gah@0r, and its
people cannot reach the outside world.
screenshot_portrait_adventurer:
Oh, yes. Judging by your appearance, you seem
to be an adventurer... I'm afraid I have some
unfortunate news.
screenshot_portrait_guild:
But don't worry. That doesn't mean there is no
work for adventurers. We simply have no
organization called an Adventurers' Guild.
